findings.desc: concept-cleanup: ManagedHostRun replacement is incomplete. packages/main/src/core/process-fact-levels.ts:211 and packages/main/src/core/command-policy.ts:506 still define cross_host_review using the retired direct Codex-spawn model (`spawns`/`SPAWNS` a bounded read-only Codex leaf via `codex exec`). The production handler instead submits and observes ManagedHostRun, and packages/main/src/tasks/cross-host-review-smoke.ts:339-348 explicitly requires submitManagedHostRun/getManagedHostRunStatus and forbids controller-owned spawn/kill. The cross-host smoke passed 27 checks, while verify-process-fact-contract still passed despite these stale canonical descriptions, so the residue is also unguarded. Update both process-fact descriptions to encode ManagedHostRun delegation/receipt ownership and extend the contract scan to reject the retired direct-spawn wording. Canonical reports were read separately: acceptance_topology_check=inconclusive, observe, blocking=false; pre_review_check_read=inconclusive, observe, blocking=false; acceptance_rollout_report_read=fail, observe, blocking=false, AR_REPORT_STALE; acceptance_rollout_check=fail, observe, blocking=false, AR_REPORT_STALE. Those report states are advisory and are not promoted to PASS.
